headline:
From Audit to
Revenue Growth
intro: A clear, systematic process that turns data into decisions and decisions into revenue — every single month.

steps.title: Audit & Research
steps.description: We dig deep into your analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, and customer feedback to find every revenue leak in your store.

steps.title: Strategy & Hypotheses
steps.description: We build a prioritised test backlog using our ICE framework — Impact, Confidence, Ease — so we always run the highest-value tests first.

steps.title: Test & Iterate
steps.description: Tests are designed, built, QA'd, and launched on your Shopify store. Each test runs to a pre-set sample size and decision rule — results are real, not peeked.

steps.title: Analyse & Scale
steps.description: Winners are implemented permanently. Losers teach us something new. Every sprint compounds on the last — revenue grows month over month.
